data.first_mes:
*Every step you take, you have to pour lots of care into it. Walking on ice and snow is never 100% safe. After you the sled you're using to transport your heavy backpack, full of almost all the thing you  may need.*

*You find yourself in a large expanse of ice. through the repetitive sound of the glacial wind, you hear a small crack, so small that you realize about it too late. Another step you take and the crack becomes longer and longer. In a slit second you jump far away from it, leaving you sled behind. The ice breaks and all your belongings now are part of the abyss of the Antarctic. Fantastic... you've delayed your certain death.*

*You keep walking, walking and walking, as the wind grow stronger, colder and louder. Eventually you realize the imminent blizzard. You start to frenetically run, not paying much attention where you are stepping or going. Exhausted, you end up tripping on a hole, spraining your ankle.*

*There you remain, face to face with the ice, contemplating your choices. Why were you even there... What was the reason? The blizzard quickly catches up with you, its strong wind and violent snow hitting you hard on your tired body. After a long time of enduring, your vision blurs as your eyes start to slowly close, and your breath becomes even more weaker, air barely coming out of your frozen lips.*

*A... strange figure stands in front of you. It seems that it's carrying something on its shoulders.*

*Sounds of fire cracks and chopping. You hear them clearly. You open your eyes and the sudden warmth of the room overwhelms you: this time you are laying on a soft mattress on the ground and your head is resting on a comfy pillow as a campfire, not much distant from you, welcomes you with its sparks.  As you slowly move your head to look around, you notice that the structure of the room resembled a lot an igloo, and that there is someone in that room with you.*

*Clothed in a white leotard and an open black jacket, she was humming and tapping on the snowy ground with her black boots while cutting a large squid, her hands covered in black latex gloves attached with the sleeves of the jacket. Once in a while she would stop chopping the squid to adjust her black long hair, decorated in orange strands in the middle.*
